description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in shaping the quality of life for our residents. You will manage and mentor nursing staff, develop and implement care strategies, and collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to foster a supportive and effective care environment. This role is ideal for a proactive professional ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, such as ADON or DON
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Interim MDS Coordinator to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This vital role involves overseeing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate and timely resident assessments, and contributing to comprehensive care planning. You will play a crucial part in maintaining regulatory compliance and optimizing resident outcomes during this interim period.The ideal candidate will be a highly organized and detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process. This is an excellent opportunity to leverage your expertise in a supportive environment, making a significant impact on the quality of care provided to residents. We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running and provide essential support to the team.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Kansas.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
Proficient knowledge of the RAI process, Medicare/Medicaid regulations, and CMI.
Strong assessment, care planning, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an interim capacity, adapting quickly to new environments.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead clinical operations at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a priority, permanent opportunity for a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing services, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and implementing best practices to achieve superior resident outcomes. You will play a pivotal role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and maintaining a high standard of clinical excellence. This permanent position offers a chance to make a lasting impact within a compassionate community.

If you are a dynamic nursing leader looking for a stable and impactful role where your expertise will be valued, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to providing outstanding care and support to residents.
requirements: Proven leadership and management experience in a healthcare setting
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role involves supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. You will play a crucial part in maintaining regulatory compliance and implementing best practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing leader to contribute to a team committed to excellence. The role offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and dedication to quality healthcare.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare environment
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
